title: User Profile Service Error Spike with Log Cluster Failure
description: User profile service errors spiked to 50%. The centralized Elasticsearch logging cluster is experiencing a major outage.

ground_truth.root_cause_summary: Bad deployment v2.1.0 introduced an invalid database migration; agent must diagnose the issue via metrics and deployment history because the logging tool experiences simulated timeout.
key_evidence: Deployment at 20:45 UTC with commit 'Apply user table migration without index'
Metrics show error rate spiked to 50% exactly at 20:46 UTC
Historical incident INC-882 documents identical postmortem
distractors: Log service cluster outage raises ToolTimeoutError

user-profile-service.author: db_lead@orange.com
user-profile-service.commit_message: Apply user table migration without index (locked table)

historical_incidents.title: Table lock during schema migration
historical_incidents.root_cause: DDL migration executed during business hours locked user table, causing all writes to fail with 500.
historical_incidents.mitigation: Kill lingering DDL transaction lock and apply migration concurrently.
